title: Shrimp Tom Yum Soup
subtitle: Thai sour-spicy soup. 8 min prep, 12 min cook.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Big white prawns at Tops/Villa frozen aisle. Defrost in cold water 10 min. Reserve shells for the stock if you have time.

ingredients.note: Knorr cubes are fine. Or boil shrimp shells in water 10 min.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Mae Pranom or Mae Ploy tub. The local default — saves chasing fresh galangal.
Fresh aisle at Tops. Skip if not available — paste covers most of the work.
Canned straw mushrooms in the Thai aisle. Or oyster mushrooms fresh.
Mae Pranom roasted-chili-in-oil jar. The thing that turns the broth orange and dangerous.

substitutions.note: Sliced thin, poaches in 3 min. Becomes tom yum gai.
Cut in 3cm chunks, add last 4 min.

steps.text: Bring stock to a simmer in a pot. Drop in kaffir leaves and lemongrass. Simmer 4 min.
Stir in tom yum paste and chili paste until dissolved. Add mushrooms, simmer 3 min.
Add tomatoes and shrimp. Simmer 2–3 min until shrimp curl and turn pink.
Kill heat. Stir in fish sauce, lime juice, smashed chilies.
Taste. Should hit sour first, then heat, then salt. Adjust lime / chili / fish sauce in that order.

serves_with.note: Optional. Most Thais eat it as soup-with-rice.

notes: The Thai protein bargain. Shrimp is essentially fat-free pure protein, and tom yum is broth-based. 290 kcal for 56g protein is impossible to beat. Add lime juice OFF the heat — boiling lime turns it bitter.
